title: Pricing a Rate Lock Commitment Float-Down by the Size of the Rate Improvement
content:
**Rate sheet note: improvement pricing for Rate Lock Commitment float-downs.** The size of the rate improvement decides the points on which the float-down fee points are built. The improvement is the lock's locked rate less the rate on its latest float-down request, to three decimal places.

**Rule.**

- When the improvement is at least the deep-improvement threshold of **0.500**, the fee points are priced per eighth of improvement. That is the per-eighth points of **0.125** times the improvement divided by one eighth of a percent (**0.125**), rounded to three decimal places.
- When the improvement is at least the mid-improvement threshold of **0.375** but below 0.500, the fee points are the lock's float-down fee points plus the mid-improvement add of **0.125**.
- Otherwise the fee points are the lock's float-down fee points.

| Improvement (percent) | Fee points |
|---|---|
| Below 0.375 | The product's float-down fee points |
| 0.375 up to, but not including, 0.500 | The product's float-down fee points plus 0.125 |
| 0.500 or more | 0.125 times the improvement divided by 0.125 |

**Float-down fee points by product**

| Rate Lock Commitment product | Float-down fee points |
|---|---|
| Larkspur 15-Day Rate Lock | 0.000 (no float-down offered) |
| Larkspur 30-Day Rate Lock | 0.000 (no float-down offered) |
| Larkspur 45-Day Rate Lock | 0.250 |
| Larkspur 60-Day Rate Lock | 0.250 |
| Larkspur 90-Day Rate Lock | 0.375 |
| Larkspur 120-Day Extended Rate Lock | 0.500 |
| Larkspur 180-Day New Construction Rate Lock | 0.500 |

### Hypothetical cases (Larkspur 60-Day Rate Lock)

- Improvement 0.250: fee points 0.250.
- Improvement 0.375: 0.250 plus 0.125, which is 0.375.
- Improvement 0.500: 0.125 times 0.500 divided by 0.125, which is 0.500.
- Improvement 0.625: 0.125 times 0.625 divided by 0.125, which is 0.625.
